data.description: Burj Khalifa View | Rare 3BR Sanctuary | Spacious
data.display_address: Residences 13, District One, Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai
data.long_description:
There's a particular feeling that comes with seeing the Burj Khalifa from your own living room not from a hotel bar, not from a rooftop you're visiting for an evening, but from home. That sense of I made it here doesn't fade. It's there every morning with your coffee, and every evening when the tower lights up against the dark.


  This apartment gives you that, plus something just as rare in Residences 12: real space. Most homes in this building are one or two bedrooms. This one is three, 1,639 sq ft of it which means room to actually live. A study that becomes an office. A guest room that means family can stay. Four bathrooms, so nobody's rushing anyone on a Monday morning.


  It's furnished, so the only thing you need to bring is the life you're about to start living in it. Parking's sorted. It's ready now.


 Master bedroom + 2 further bedrooms
 4 bathrooms
 Fully furnished, move-in ready
 1 parking space
 Direct Burj Khalifa & Downtown Dubai view


  And beyond your door  District One's gated calm, the Crystal Lagoon, 8.4km of trails to walk off the day with Downtown and DIFC still close enough to reach in minutes.


  Homes like this, with this view, in this layout, don't sit around for long.


AED 190,000/year | Furnished | 1 Parking | Available Now
